# Bulk MD Pilot Replicate QC Report

## Final gate: **DESCRIPTOR_GATE_PASS**

## Design

- Three independent packings selected by chemistry only: aliphatic polyamide, aromatic sulfone, and rigid heteroaromatic.
- Each has all four temperatures and 200 ps production, yielding 12 paired polymer-temperature states.
- Pairwise relative errors use the original absolute descriptor magnitude as denominator; summaries report their observed p10/median/p90 distribution.
- Reproducibility compares median absolute replicate error to the median original between-polymer SD at the same temperature. Temperature-trend consistency is the fraction of the three polymers with matching original/replicate slope sign.

## Interpretation

- Robust static packing descriptors: heavy_coordination_mean, heavy_coordination_mean_firsthalf_secondhalf_pct, heavy_coordination_std, intermolecular_contact_count_per_atom, intermolecular_contact_count_per_atom_block_sd, intermolecular_contact_count_per_atom_firsthalf_secondhalf_pct, intermolecular_heavy_contact_fraction, intermolecular_heavy_contact_fraction_block_cv, intermolecular_heavy_contact_fraction_block_sd, intermolecular_rdf_first_shell_coordination, intermolecular_rdf_first_shell_coordination_firsthalf_secondhalf_pct, mean_density, mean_volume_A3, specific_volume_cm3_g.
- Dynamics descriptors usable for later ML (subject to retaining QC flags): MSD_100ps_A2, MSD_10ps_A2, MSD_50ps_A2, generic_torsion_autocorr_100ps, generic_torsion_autocorr_10ps, generic_torsion_autocorr_50ps, generic_torsion_persistence_100ps, generic_torsion_persistence_10ps, generic_torsion_persistence_50ps, generic_torsion_transition_rate_per_ps_100ps, generic_torsion_transition_rate_per_ps_10ps, generic_torsion_transition_rate_per_ps_50ps, interchain_contact_persistence_100ps, interchain_contact_persistence_10ps, interchain_contact_persistence_50ps, packing_contact_block_cv, packing_contact_block_sd, packing_contact_firsthalf_secondhalf_pct.
- Classification is evidence-based: ROBUST indicates replicate error below half of selected-cohort between-polymer variation and consistent trends in at least two polymers; USABLE_WITH_NOISE indicates error below between-polymer variation with a majority-consistent trend; remaining descriptors are UNSTABLE. The complete observed error distributions are in `results/bulk_md_tg_pilot_replicate_qc.csv`.

## Stop condition

No Tg model was trained and no 150-polymer cohort was started.
